valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (netcarelimited) is served under two keys, NTCP.JO and NTCP, whose market multiples disagree (PE None vs 81.35); one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 5%: market cap 125110000000 used (price x shares) vs 132243014656 on file
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 74.43, price over EPS 67.83); the net-profit row does not reconcile with the filing's own profit before tax less tax while price x shares x EPS does, so the P/E is price over the verified earnings-per-share row
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 19.91 percent a year from FY2022 (9.75e+08) to FY2025 (1.681e+09), over 3 years
